thread:
mindy: heads-up — bringing up hf/llama-4x on staging for a quantization pass. initial smoke looks ok but saw a weird quality dip on long-context chatter (6k+).
sanjay: what kind of dip? perf or semantic drift?
mindy: semantic. repeating sentences and hallucinating dates. metric-wise rouge-l down ~4 points vs fp16 baseline on our longcontext eval set. short context (<512) is fine.
olivia: timeline? config?
mindy: started with our usual int4 config: `q4_0 -> dynamic_kv_cache` and default rotary scale. canary deployed model variant `llama-4x-q4-dyn` at 2101234567.
kai: can you paste the eval diff?
mindy: sure, quick paste:```
- fp16 baseline: rouge-l 0.72
- q4 dyn: rouge-l 0.68
- failure rate (repeats>3): 1.2% -> 5.6%
```

sanjay: hmm that smells like rotary or kvcache misalignment rather than vocab. any tokenizer warnings when loading?
mindy: saw a small warning from tokenizer loader about unknown bytes for a handful of tokens in the tail of vocab. 50256..50270 region maps differently when we convert from hf to our runtime id mapping.
olivia: oh right — new hf vocab for this release introduced 14 extra tokens anchored at high ids. our converter shifts those into an alias bucket in the runtime. that can change rotary index mapping if we reuse absolute token ids for pos embeddings.
kai: so two hypotheses: token id aliasing -> stale KV lookups; or rotary angle mismatch because model expects headwise scaling for 80% head dim. did you try toggling rotary_scale param?
mindy: toggled `--rotary-scale=1.0` (default) -> `0.9` and `0.7`. small improvement at 0.9, big at 0.7 but still not back to baseline.

evalbot: automated bisect started: running: baseline fp16, q4-dyn + fix-tokenmap, q4-dyn + rotary-headwise, q4-dyn + both. ETA ~40m. (:hourglass_flowing_sand:)

sanjay: can we try a quick runtime patch to remap the 14 tail tokens to contiguous slot ids instead of aliasing? that should preserve rotary index positions.
mindy: tried remap patch locally — re-ran 200-sample eval: rouge-l jumped from 0.68 -> 0.70, repeats halved. copy of the failing prompt attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/rw/llama4x-rotary-sample
olivia: great. any quant-specific artifacts? e.g., clipping in the output logits after dequant?
kai: looked at logits histograms: q4 produced heavier tails and occasional extreme spikes at step ~1200 tokens when long context re-used old KV entries. aligns w/ alias+kvcache hypothesis.
sanjay: plan: 1) land tokenmap remap in staging, 2) add runtime assert to reject aliased high-token ids unless explicit mapping present, 3) run full eval suite overnight.
mindy: added PR for remap -> `#4397` (staging). deploy-bot: canary deploy `llama-4x-q4-dyn` with remap completed at 2101234590. :rocket:
evalbot: canary eval results (first 2h): q4-dyn+remap rouge-l 0.71, repeats down to 1.5%, latency +3% p50. full suite still running.
kai: next: test headwise rotary scaling option (`--rotary-mode=headwise`) because model training logs mention headwise scale factor 0.8. try that after remap if any residual gap.
olivia: also add tokenizer integration test to CI to detect future tail-token insertions — fail the conversion if new top-token ids aren't explicitly mapped.
sanjay: agreed. i'll open follow-up tickets for CI and runtime assert.
mindy: thanks all — will monitor full eval. leaving canary running for 12h, will rollback only if regression reappears. :thumbsup:
